svg.title: The Meta-Harness pipeline
svg.desc: From a game name: a study agent researches the game on the web and writes study documents; an adapt agent writes a game adaptor validated by a generic smoke test; the harness search loop has a proposer write harness candidates, pre-flights them with stand-in models, evaluates them with real models on the game clock, archives code, traces and scores, and ranks them; the best harness is evaluated on unseen seeds and an unseen game.
svg.text: read everything, diagnose, propose one hypothesis

text.tspan: · nothing game-specific is written by hand · the proposer sees only the archive and the public interface
Scores are honest: a tick without a fresh decision replays the last action, and that stale tick is counted
